outcome: complication rate associated with external cephalic version
cohort: 1121 women who underwent an ECV at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital in Sydney, Australia from 1995 to 2013
finding: External cephalic version (ECV) at term is associated with a low rate of serious complications.
mod_finding: The study found that external cephalic version (ECV) at term was associated with a low rate of serious complications.
